name: RSDP Custom My Account Design
author: Deepak Vishwakarma

sections.description:
RSDP Custom My Account Design is a powerful WooCommerce plugin designed to transform the default “My Account” page into a user-friendly interface with separate tabs for login and signup. This plugin is perfect for WooCommerce store owners who want to improve their customers’ experience by providing a clean, organized, and intuitive way to log in or register.

Key Features:

  • Custom Tabs for Login and Signup: Replace the default WooCommerce “My Account” page with a tabbed interface for login and registration.
  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration: Fully compatible with WooCommerce’s login and registration system.
  • Dynamic Content Display: Show the WooCommerce customer dashboard for logged-in users and login/signup tabs for logged-out users.
  • Smooth Tab Navigation: Use jQuery to switch between login and signup forms effortlessly.
  • WooCommerce Notices: Display error/success messages for login and registration.
  • Customizable Design: Includes custom CSS for styling the tabs and forms to match your store’s design.
  • Mobile-Friendly: Responsive design works perfectly on all devices.

Why Choose This Plugin?

  • Improves User Experience: Makes it easier for customers to log in or sign up.
  • Boosts Conversions: A well-designed login/signup process can increase customer registrations.
  • Easy to Use: No coding required—just install, activate, and customize.
  • Fully Customizable: Change colors and styles to match your brand.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. You are free to modify and distribute it, but any distributed versions must also be licensed under the GPL.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the plugin support page.

SEO Keywords

Additional Notes

  • This plugin is designed to work with WooCommerce. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  • For best results, use the latest version of WordPress and WooCommerce.
  • Customize the tab colors to match your store’s branding for a cohesive look.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, click Activate Plugin.
  5. Go to the My Account Design settings page (under Settings > My Account Design) to customize the tab colors and styles.
sections.faq:
Q: Does this plugin work with the latest version of WooCommerce?

A: Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce 6.7 and above.

Q: Can I customize the colors of the tabs?

A: Yes, the plugin includes a settings page where you can customize the tab background color, text color, and more.

Q: Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

A: Absolutely! The plugin is fully responsive and works seamlessly on all devices.

Q: Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

A: No, this plugin is designed for ease of use. No coding skills are required.
